items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well I was going to ask these concerts at the Keough and all of them, Dave, where would they be?

ctx.x: Old Gasper, well I remember him when he was playing with Robey Shows Band Bass, orchestra, not the band. Played bass violin, strictly a bass violin man, and a good bass violin. And uh, did you know that going at Machine Bill? No, I remember. He played, I saw him play about four or five jobs. Once with many, twice with many careers. And he also played with George Moray, bass violin. He had a little concert. I think it was on Tulane Avenue.
Well I was going to ask these concerts at the Keough and all of them, Dave, where would they be? What kind of an auditorium?
Well they had it in the, in the, uh, Narkeeson Hall, Franz Ami Hall. North Carolina Hall. Yes, they had it. And you pay so much to go in.
